events.action: Pumped a 41 bbl LCM pill and reduced flow. Losses cured.
events.remarks: Pre-treat with 15 ppb LCM and hold ECD under 12.6 ppg.

events.title: Bit balling in sticky clay
events.narrative: ROP fell to 3 m/h with low torque, bit balled in sticky clay.
events.action: Pumped a detergent sweep and raised flow. ROP recovered.
events.remarks: Run a detergent sweep every 150 m in the Girujan.

events.title: Tight hole on trip
events.narrative: Overpull of 12 t at 1,325 m while pulling out of hole.
events.action: Worked through with back-reaming and circulated the hole clean.
events.remarks: Back-ream stands through the Girujan on every trip.

events.title: Coal-shale caving, pack-off

events.action: Pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud weight to 10.9 ppg.
events.remarks: Caved at 10.4 ppg, hole stable at 10.9 ppg.

messages.text: Drilling 12¼ in hole in Tipam at 2,860 m. WOB 16 t, 120 rpm, 900 gpm.
Drilling break at 2,872 m, ROP 24 → 12 m/h.
Samples from 2,872 m due at the shakers 03:11, lag 54 min.
Barail top called at 2,872 m. Cuttings shale 60%, sandstone 30%, coal traces.
